_readme: Roadmap shown on collaborate.html. status: done | doing | todo. Add items with a pull request.

items.title: Confirm pixels per tube, power per metre and the XLR pinout with the supplier
Design and prototype tip hubs (3-way) and middle hubs (8-way with bridle eye)
Weigh a tube and a hub; update masses in merkaba.json
Choose a DMX interface with enough universes
Stand-alone Merkaba controller.py (DMX output, effects, audio reactive)
Pick winches, check ceiling load rating, plan safety cables
Bench test: one universe of tubes on the bench with the address test effect
